How Many Passengers Fit in a Stretch Limo?

Understand stretch limousine capacity for your event planning. Choose the right size for comfort and celebration.

Standard Stretch Limousine Capacity

Typical Sizes

8-Passenger Stretch: our Chrysler Limo, $150/hour

  • Comfortable: 6-7 passengers
  • Maximum: 8 passengers
  • Best for: Small wedding parties, date nights, airport VIP

10-Passenger Stretch: an industry size we do not run; our nearest fit is the Maybach Jet Sprinter (up to 9), $295/hour

  • Comfortable: 8-9 passengers
  • Maximum: 10 passengers
  • Best for: Prom groups, birthday celebrations, small parties

12-14 Passenger Stretch: an industry size we do not run; our nearest fit is the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax), $175/hour

  • Comfortable: 10-12 passengers
  • Maximum: 14 passengers
  • Best for: Bachelor/bachelorette parties, larger groups

Factors Affecting Comfort

Attire Considerations

  • Wedding gowns require extra space
  • Formal attire needs room to avoid wrinkling
  • Group costumes may need accommodation

Luggage & Items

  • Airport trips reduce effective capacity
  • Coolers and party supplies need space
  • Gifts and decorations take room

Trip Duration

  • Quick transfers: Maximum capacity works
  • Multi-hour events: Plan for comfort capacity
  • All-day rentals: Build in extra space

When to Size Up

Choose larger when:

  • Wearing formal/bulky attire
  • Trip exceeds 2 hours
  • Bringing supplies or luggage
  • Wanting room to move around

Maximum works for:

  • Short airport transfers
  • Casual attire events
  • Quick point-to-point trips

Alternative Options

Need more space?

  • Limo Party Sprinter: 13 or 16 passengers, $175/hour
  • Party Bus (28 Pax): 28 passengers, $250/hour
  • Pink Hummer Limo (a stretch Hummer): 18 passengers, $295/hour

There is a 4-hour minimum on most vehicles (5 hours for the 56-Passenger Motorcoach), and there are no sedans in our fleet. Prices are before 8% Arizona sales tax. Every rate is on the pricing page.
